name: Vaultquake

stealth.details: to see the ley line energy retreating throughout the cavern

disable: DC 31 Arcana check, DC 31 Nature check, DC 31 Occultism check, or DC 31 Religion check (master) to disperse the ley line's power as it retreats, or DC 27 Survival check (expert) to predict where rubble might fall next. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the cavern, ending the hazard.
reset: After 4 rounds, the hazard ends automatically as the vaultquake subsides.
routine: (1 action) The GM rolls a DC 9 Flat check to determine if a cave-in occurs. On a successful check, falling rubble deals 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage to a random PC (DC 30 basic Reflex save save). On a critical success, the collapse deals 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage to all the PCs instead.

items.name: Disorienting Screech
items.text:
Trigger The vaultline retreats.

---
Effect Each creature in the area attempts a DC 30 Will save save with the following effects. The hazard then rolls initiative.

---
Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Stunned 1 and Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned 2 and stupefied 1 for an indefinite duration.

text: The retreating vaultline causes a series of cave-ins.
